title: About me
text: Hello! My name is Romy Vuurman, and I am a second-year master’s student in Methodology and Statistics for the Behavioral, Biomedical and Social Sciences at Utrecht University. Prior to this, I completed a bachelor’s degree in Communication Science at the University of Amsterdam as an honours student, in which I also did a minor in Personality- and Development Psychology at Lund University in Sweden. Currently, I am writing my master’s thesis at Statistics Netherlands on energy-related experiences and behaviours.

title: About this site
text: This site showcases my work, including my curriculum vitae.
